title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

title: Christmas at the Inn
description: Beth Green, a devoted café owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcomes military families and veterans who might otherwise spend Christmas alone. At her parents' cozy inn, Beth meets Jack Evans, a civil engineer with the military, assigned to oversee projects at the local base over Christmas.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

title: Christmas at the Drive-In
description: A property lawyer finds romance during the holidays while trying to save her town's local drive-in from closing down.

title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
description: A designer visits her Ozark hometown for Christmas, reconnecting with family craft traditions and faith. Through Paul's support, she discovers meaning in work centered on community and heritage.

title: Silver Bells at Christmas
description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

title: A Little Women's Christmas
description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

title: Three Generations, One Christmas
description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.

title: A Rescue Dog for Christmas
description: A physician and a traveling veterinarian unite to organize a Christmas pet adoption event and discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts find shelter.

title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary
description: In the third Home Sweet Christmas story, Sophie and Sam travel to festive Budapest to celebrate their first anniversary, but their romantic getaway soon turns into a mystery when a charismatic hotelier pulls them into a world of surprises.

title: The Trouble With Christmas Mistletoe
description: An executive returns home for Christmas and reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

title: Fir Crazy
description: A reluctant Christmas-tree seller (Sarah Lancaster) finds renewed holiday spirit and new romance with a repeat customer (Eric Johnson), but a mean-spirited executive (Colin Mochrie) threatens to shut down her family's business.

title: A Royal Christmas Tail
description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
description: Divorced for five years, Anna and James reluctantly agree to meet their daughter's boyfriend at a rustic cabin. But when an ice storm traps them in the mountains, they're forced to confront the history they share as old feelings resurface.

title: Christmas North of Nashville
description: A woman rediscovers love, community, and the holiday spirit after returning home to save her family's Christmas carnival.

title: Chasing Christmas
description: When a Christmas wishes tree brings together an artist and a morning show host, they set out on a mission to make a child's holiday dreams come true.

title: Destined at Christmas
description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

title: The Christmas Yes List
description: A chronic people-pleaser returns home for Christmas, determined to finally say yes to herself. An unexpected romance helps her discover that life's greatest gifts often come when you stop fearing the answer.

title: Let It Snow
description: An executive examines her company's new property and prepares a presentation to transform the rustic lodge into a new hot spot. She tries to ignore the lodge's festive celebrations during her stay, but an unexpected romance changes her heart.

title: A Rescue Dog for Christmas
description: A physician and a traveling veterinarian unite to organize a Christmas pet adoption event and discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts find shelter.

title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
description: When a setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb rely on faith, love and community.
